description.fun: A little larva that eats snow off the ground. It likes it soft and freshly fallen, so it eats its way up the mountain toward the peak, and the more it eats, the bigger and more impressive the icy spikes on its back grow. When it sleeps, it ties itself to a branch with frosty thread and passes for an icicle.
description.guide: A small Ice and Bug-type larva Pokémon that feeds on snow. Snom evolves into Frosmoth when levelled up with high friendship at night, the only Generation VIII Pokémon that evolves through friendship.
description.tagline: A larva that eats its way up a snowy mountain

description.fun: Its huge wings are colder than −180 °C, and as it flies over fields and mountains, icy scales drift from them and fall like snow. Clean meltwater is its favourite drink. It's gentle, but it shows no mercy to anyone who desecrates the fields and mountains, chasing them off with a blizzard.
description.guide: The evolution of Snom, an Ice and Bug-type moth Pokémon whose frozen wings shed snow-like scales. It protects fields and mountains from those who damage them.
description.tagline: A guardian moth that sheds snowflake scales
